seo.title: Desh Bhakt — Love for the nation, shown in action
seo.description: Stories of freedom, the Constitution and everyday civic duty. Desh Bhakt helps every citizen turn love for India into action.

blocks.heading: Love for the nation, shown in action
blocks.sub: True patriotism is not only slogans on a holiday. It is knowing our history, respecting our Constitution and doing our duty every single day.

cards.title: Stories of freedom
cards.text: Lesser-known accounts of the people and movements that won our independence.

cards.title: Know your Constitution
cards.text: Plain-language explanations of our rights, duties and institutions.

cards.title: Civic service
cards.text: Simple, everyday actions: cleanliness, voting, respect for public property.

cards.title: National symbols
cards.text: The meaning of the Tiranga, the Anthem and the Emblem, and how to honour them.

items.title: Learn
items.text: Read an article and share what you learn with your family.

items.title: Act
items.text: Pick one small civic action in your neighbourhood this month.

items.title: Inspire
items.text: Tell us what you did so we can encourage others to do the same.

blocks.heading: Ready to serve the nation?
blocks.text: Write to us. Whether you have an hour a week or an idea to share, there is a place for you.
